name: tab-volume-clean
description: Firefox/Zen extension: per-tab volume from 0 to 600% with a plain linear gain, WebRTC included

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files "test/**" "node_modules/**" "dist/**" package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename "tab-volume-clean-{version}.xpi" --ignore-files "test/**" "node_modules/**" "dist/**" package.json package-lock.json README.md .gitignore
